title: Tim Taylor of Aerospace Corporation takes orders from an angel
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tim Taylor of Aerospace Corporation takes orders from an angel, about Challenger era to present at Aerospace Corporation / NASA, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this guy I mentioned, Tim Taylor at Aerospace Corporation, he's saying he's taking orders from an angel

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a man named Tim Taylor, who he says works at Aerospace Corporation, a company that does space work for the US government and NASA, the American space agency. Michels says Taylor claims he is taking orders from an angel. If true, it would mean someone inside the space world says he is guided by a non-human being.
